recordings.title: Campus, companions and everyday weapons
recordings.summary: University surroundings become flowing side-scrolling terrain. A student uses campus objects; a cute Dexter companion could gradually become a secret antagonist. Drones, device progression and replay professor bosses are ideas, not a required roster.

recordings.title: Scene layers and production method
recordings.summary: Compose long scenes in one visual language, then derive masks and depth layers. Web delivery and AI-assisted iteration are proposed. Claims about easy collision, animation and universal portability are unverified production expectations.

recordings.title: Collect references while the light is good
recordings.summary: Collect campus photographs while light and weather are favorable. No new gameplay decision.

recordings.title: The chair as a melee weapon
recordings.summary: Swinging a chair supplies an everyday-object melee joke. Pose pieces and in-between frames need visual and animation QA; the machine transcript contains an ambiguous can/cannot statement.

recordings.title: Worldbuilding reference and project ownership
recordings.summary: Use Infinity Blade as a worldbuilding reference while preserving Vatsal’s ownership. Aim for one finished set, with more sets later. Later written clarification narrows the reference to post-technological civilization.

recordings.title: Playground and interior reveals
recordings.summary: The Playground animation inspires surreal digital corruption and a possible climbing-playground stage. Scene masks could reveal pipe interiors on approach. This is a proposed presentation technique.

recordings.title: Reflection-world traversal
recordings.summary: A friend proposes exploration, parkour and some combat, with a reflection below the pond becoming a traversable parallel space. This begins the later reflection discussion.

recordings.title: Secret-boss scope · recognition disputed
recordings.summary: Discusses secret bosses and planning beyond the jam. Both new API passes recognize a positive recommendation; an earlier local review recognized a negation. The source remains disputed. Do not use this note to override the later written instruction to defer replay extras.

review.conflict: Earlier local review: not recommend; unresolved intended negation.

recordings.title: Touch, crash-spin and economical comedy
recordings.summary: An inexpensive pond interaction can reuse a pickup/touch pose, a crash-like spin and a safe arrival rather than a cinematic. Classic Monkey Island and Planet of Lana are suggested play references for economical interactions.

recordings.title: Photo-to-pixel workflow recollection
recordings.summary: Recalls using photographs, pixel conversion and image editing to build art and animation. The historical claim about how most old games were made is a recollection, not verified research.

recordings.title: Team meeting · scope, tone and level design
recordings.summary: The team discusses a familiar campus becoming increasingly uncanny, without relying on gore or an apocalypse. A quantum-computing field experiment is positively received as a premise. Finish one character and one level before expanding. Lex is asked for authored, asymmetric stage sketches with routes, secrets and encounters. The theme is reported as “spooky outside”; AI-rule remarks conflict and need an organizer answer. Controls, title, pixel scale and final stage remain open.
recordings.upload_preparation: Original 35.66 MB M4A transcoded to mono 24 kHz MP3 at 48 kbps for the 25 MB upload limit; original preserved.

recordings.title: Lex discussion · travel and Dexter
recordings.summary: Reflective anomalies could connect areas; slide-based fast travel is an alternative. Dexter is discussed as a plush guide that absorbs defeated anomalies, grows more humanoid and may betray the player. Attached charge-meter companion and intermittent trader versions are unresolved. Chair-first melee, a later returning tray, avoidable drones, backtracking and authored expansion are discussed.

recordings.title: Travel clarification · conduit or fast travel
recordings.summary: Clarifies two alternatives: reflective surfaces as the main conduit for discovering areas/upgrades, or as fast travel. The cheap touch/damage-spin transition remains a proposal. Neither alternative is selected.
